### It’s Okay to Pass This Test
Author: Kevin DeYoung
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/kevin-deyoung/its-okay-to-pass-this-test/
Passage: 2 Corinthians 13:5
Points:
- Paul's call to examine ourselves is frequently used to drive rigorous spiritual introspection.
- Self-examination turns destructive when believers feel they are never permitted to pass the exam.
- In 2 Corinthians 13, Paul actually anticipated that the Corinthian believers would pass the test.
- Since Christ truly indwells His people, Christians have genuine grounds to know they are in the faith.
- Testing our hearts is valuable, but believers can give themselves a passing grade to God's glory.
